description: NaK₃H₄ crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. The structure consists of one Na cluster inside a K₃H₄ framework. In the Na cluster, Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to  atoms. In the K₃H₄ framework, K is bonded to six H atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing KH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-H bond lengths are 2.76 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded to six equivalent K atoms to form corner-sharing HK₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent K atoms.
